correctness.rationale: The 6-dimensional vanishing space is established by the 20-term cubic monomial reduction against the 6 Frobenius commutator relations. The gradient equals the alternating matrix applied to the coordinate square vector, so smoothness is equivalent to nonzero Pfaffian. A complete enumeration of all 63 nonzero matrices gives 28 nondegenerate forms and 56 pencils; elementary transvections generate all of their one group orbit. A second extension-field enumeration verifies 5 binary spread lines and 2 conjugate transversals. Dependent gradients force transversal multiplicities at least 2, and the complete intersection degree 9 forces exact fundamental cycle 5+2+2 and no hidden geometric components. Maximal dimension follows from a ternary quadratic zero. Both code paths were run successfully from the packaged file paths. The arithmetic genera follow from adjunction and the nodal incidence graph.

originality.rationale: Directly relevant complete primary texts establish strong ingredients: nondegenerate alternating Frobenius forms, regular-spread/external-Klein-line correspondence, and the same seven-line cubic-surface construction. These components are not claimed original. A comparison of their stated conclusions found no complete count/orbit/maximality of all smooth cubic-surface filling pencils together with the scheme-theoretic doubled base cycle. Literature and published-finding corpus searches did not locate a covering statement. This is a cautious same-model priority assessment, not certified uniqueness.
residual_risks: Classical seven-line configurations explicitly appear in Swinnerton--Dyer (2010), so the incidence pattern is not novel and may implicitly determine doubled base lines.
Regular spreads and external Klein lines are classically equivalent, so the numerical census might follow from unindexed finite-geometry tables.
The alternating form characterization in Asgarli--Duan--Lai (2022) nearly supplies the individual-surface classification.
No independent expert historical-priority assessment has been conducted.

value.rationale: The question of all pencils with every rational member smooth and passing through the entire smallest projective three-space is a motivated extremal linear-system classification, rather than an arbitrary parameter slice. The theorem determines the entire family, the single symmetry type, the impossibility of larger all-smooth subspaces, and the forced nonreduced base curve. Unlike a simple point count, this distinguishes smooth fiber behavior from a necessarily nonreduced complete intersection. The pre-existing seven-line geometry limits the incremental scope but the exact universal classification and scheme-sensitive interpretation have plausible use in constructing/testing finite-field pencils.
